page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-standard-32 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor providing 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading (2 threads per core). Cache configurations include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Memory is provisioned at 128.0 GB of RAM, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio (4.0 GB per vCPU). The instance includes zero GPUs and provides no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached persistent disks for root and block volume storage. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results place the processor's stress-ng single-core performance in the strong tier (top 25% at 2696.38), while multi-core metrics settle within the average range (middle 50% at 43202.89). Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate 89.01 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 52.3 GB/sec for writes. The Geekbench suite reports a multi-core score of 13132.0 and a single-core score of 1514.0, complemented by a Clang compilation score of 23710.0. Network and memory operational tests achieve 31.49 million Redis SET operations per second and 23.71 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

Instruction set support features hardware cryptography acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI, as well as AVX, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. However, it lacks advanced instruction extensions such as AVX-512, AMX, and AVX-VNNI. Consequently, execution speed on heavy deep-learning workloads is constrained, evidenced by large 70B parameter model LLM prompt processing dropping into the bottom 25% (6.55 tokens/sec). Smaller models perform adequately on CPU, generating 257.15 tokens/sec on 135M models and 18.38 tokens/sec on 7B models.

The configuration provides solid multi-threaded throughput and memory capacity suitable for standard enterprise application servers, mid-sized relational and in-memory database engines, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and static or dynamic web serving tiers.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2d-standard-32 is a general-purpose x86_64 instance powered by a dedicated 16-core AMD EPYC 7B13 processor delivering 32 vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory. It adheres to a standard 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio, suitable for balanced workloads. The instance features no bundled local storage and zero GPUs, requiring persistent storage to be configured separately. Benchmark performance is characterized by top-quartile single-core stress-ng throughput (2696.38) and middle-tier multi-core output (43202.89), alongside 31.49 million Redis SET operations per second and 23.71 GB/sec static web throughput. Without AVX-512 or specialized accelerator support, large-scale deep learning performance is limited. It is well-suited for relational databases, Redis caching layers, Clang software compilation, and scalable web serving.
